# UISizeConstraint

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")`

Keeps its parent between two sizes (ADR 0128): a panel that is a third of the window and never under 240 units wide. A clamp, applied after the element's own `Size` and before its children are laid out.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MaxSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.zero` | read/write | The most it may be. **Zero on an axis is no limit**, which is what a new one has; `math.huge` is taken as the same and reads back as zero. |
| `MinSize` | `Vector2` | `Vector2.zero` | read/write | The least it may be, in the element's units. |
